introHtml: Frosted finishes add a soft, matte texture to household items like drinkware and storage containers, giving them an upscale look that hides fingerprints and minor scratches. Ideal for corporate gift sets or employee welcome kits, frosted surfaces accept crisp imprinting with screen printing or laser engraving, ensuring your logo stands out without glare. Choose custom frosted household items for a subtle, professional aesthetic that works well in both office breakrooms and home kitchens.
